# laravelforge Provider





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

Uses the organization scoped Laravel Forge API (`https://forge.laravel.com/api/orgs/{organization}`).
The token must be an API token with scopes, created at https://forge.laravel.com/profile/api.

### Required

- `token` (String) Also read from `LARAVELFORGE_TOKEN`.

### Optional

- `organization` (String) The slug of the Forge organization. Also read from `LARAVELFORGE_ORGANIZATION`. Defaults to the only organization the token has access to.
